The '''Gestrex system''' was a part of the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected to the [[Kegan system/Legends|Kegan]] and [[Norval system/Legends|Norval systems]] via the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Gestrex [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the terrestrial astronomical object [[Gestrex III]], which housed a [[Gestrex III Imperial Navy base|base]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG10" /> At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The former book further specifies that the [[Gestrex III Imperial Navy base]] was decimated at least five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior and following the establishment of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The [[Gestrex III]] base must have therefore been attacked sometime between 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the facility was decimated by a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. The base was subsequently abandoned.<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gestrex system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-9.<ref name="TEA" />
